description:
Elara is a 82ft Maiora flybridge motor yacht available for private charter in Dubai, offering a VIP cabin spanning the full beam, large beds and wide windows all around.

She welcomes up to 30 guests, has one cabin and is run by a professional crew of 2. Departing from Dubai Marina, she is a great choice for birthdays, family days and groups of friends, with routes past Bluewaters, Ain Dubai, the Palm Jumeirah and the Burj Al Arab.

Charters are available by the hour, for sunset cruises or for the full day. Contact Yacht Research for availability, routes and a tailored quote.
